records.name: RisersBox
records.tagline: Powerful Tools, Seamless Experience.
records.description: You Google a tool, land on an ad-ridden site, hit a file size limit, get asked to sign up, and realize your data just left your machine. Then you do it again for a QR code. Then a PDF. Then a color converter. RisersBox is one clean workspace with 150+ dev and productivity tools — no ads, no forced signups, and nearly everything processes entirely in your browser. records.description: Reduce food waste by tracking your household & food items. See donation centers (currently across Taiwan only, adding more soon) to donate excess food to. When you achieve milestones in the app when reducing food waste, we partner with TheGoodAPI to plant real trees (mangroves) in Kenya.

records.name: Boopbeep for iOS and iPadOS
records.tagline: SSH terminal, files and database manager, one time purchase
records.description: Boopbeep is a native Swift SSH terminal, files, and database client for iPhone and iPad. I built it because every existing mobile SSH app was either subscription based or didn't focus on the UI enough for my liking, and the database tooling story on iOS basically didn't exist. Boopbeep features real tabs and multitasking and windowing on iPad, amazing features, and a gorgeous UI. The app's revenue model is no IAPs, no subscriptions, ever. 5.99$ price and you're done, you own the app forever.
